Callout.Name: Electrical Burns
Callout.Message: Person burnt by a live cable at a site.

Script.Line: The cable was supposed to be dead. It was signed off.
It was in both hands and then it was not.
My hands are buzzing. They have been buzzing since it happened.

Callout.Patient: My hands feel like they are still holding it.

Lines.Approach: The power is off and the burns are on both hands. That is where the current went in and out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
